title: Agent UI · the A2UI catalogue, refined

screens.title: 1 · Day + Cards + Choices
screens.why: “organiza minha tarde”: one turn shows the afternoon, what fits, and two ways, no prose question.

pins.label: Caption
pins.text: Body ink, no bubble, ≤80 chars, only a reason the blocks can't show. Optional.

pins.label: One card shape
pins.text: Every block is the same borderless fill (r18): quiet heading left, its count right. No 1px borders anywhere.

pins.label: DayPeek free room
pins.text: Free stretches drawn as Tempo draws them (freeEdge/freeFill) with their length; heading carries the total. Heading tap → Tempo on that day.

pins.label: Kind by colour
pins.text: Fixed sand, routine blue, running accentSoft, task white. Height loosely to length (36–84pt), so an afternoon fits.

pins.label: Cards
pins.text: Heading is the model's; rows say what Lista says: where, length, project. Rows parted by a 2pt seam of the page colour.

pins.label: Choices
pins.text: Pills are now fill, not outlined. Equal weight, never the accent; a tap applies that plan, one ticked line remains.

pins.label: Detalhes
pins.text: Steps leave the answer: folded under Detalhes ⌄, quiet ink3 ticks when open.

screens.title: 2 · ProjectPeek
screens.why: “como está a Tese?”: the Projetos row as it is, then what comes next, then the way in.

pins.label: Project row
pins.text: Folders glyph (Projetos tab's AppIcons.things) + name in title size. The only block with a larger title: it names a thing, not a slice.

pins.label: Counts
pins.text: “2 de 8 feitas”, top right, ink3: the same place as the Projetos row.

pins.label: Deadline + bar
pins.text: “até seg, 30 nov · faltam 44 dias”, then the Projetos bar (accent; red once overdue). No deadline: no bar.

pins.label: Próximas · mais 3
pins.text: Up to 3 open tasks, those with an hour first; the rest counted, not listed.

pins.label: Same rows as Cards
pins.text: PeekCardRow is shared; another day is named (“amanhã 09:00”), backlog says Depois eu priorizo + length.

pins.label: Abrir projeto
pins.text: Footer text button in ink, full width: the one way into the page. No accent, the choices below may need it.

pins.label: Focus first
pins.text: The model's focus block is simply drawn first; no highlight, so the accent stays for the action.

screens.title: 3 · Notes read, then written
screens.why: Reading notes is a Cards block; writing them is a plan row the person reads in full before Aplicar.

pins.label: Cards, no heading
pins.text: One card with its notes under it (6 lines max). No heading when the model gives none: just the fill.

pins.label: Plan header
pins.text: The day it lands on; a plan with no hours says only “N mudanças”.

pins.label: edit
pins.text: Pen mark, white square; old name struck → “novo nome”.

pins.label: note
pins.text: Note mark (notePencil, new AppIcons.note). Appended text in full in a white inset with a red “+”: the person's own notes, read before written.

screens.title: 4 · The new plan rows
screens.why: Every hand gesture gets its own row: length, done, new project, and what gets pushed.

pins.label: Length
pins.text: Pen: “~~30 min~~ → 1h · duração”.

pins.label: Done
pins.text: Check in success ink on white.

pins.label: New project
pins.text: Folders in accentSoft (adds = accent family) and the tasks it starts with, as dots.

pins.label: Pushed
pins.text: ↓ in grey, as today; header counts it. Buttons turn into Outro horário / Mover.

screens.title: 5 · A delete reads as a delete
screens.why: “apaga o projeto Mudança”: what goes is named, struck, and the button says Apagar.

pins.label: Server caption
pins.text: What stays (done tasks keep their history) is said by the server, in Portuguese.

pins.label: Bin in red
pins.text: Trash in danger/dangerInk; deletes always sort first in the card; title struck.

pins.label: What goes with it
pins.text: Each backlog task that goes, struck, red dots. No ProjectPeek above a delete: the row already names it all.

pins.label: Apagar
pins.text: The apply button says Apagar, in dangerInk instead of the accent. Desfazer still takes it all back.
